issue_deck: ThreatLevelMidnight stands alone at 4-0 while the rest of the league masters the art of leaving wins on the pine.

lead_story.headline: The 31.2-Point Self-Sabotage
body: Week 4 featured a staggering display of roster mismanagement, anchored by Post Mahomes dropping a 20.06-point decision while leaving 31.20 points rotting on the bench—enough raw production to convert the loss into an 11.14-point victory. Four distinct start-sit errors fueled the collapse.

At the summit, ThreatLevelMidnight pushed to 4-0-0 via a league-high 143.12 points, pulling away from the pack. At the opposite end, Buttermilk Puuump hit rock bottom at 0-4-0 following a 46.48-point shellacking against Joe Mantegna while benching 25.40 unused points.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Five-Point Margin Built on Bench Neglect
matchup_recaps.body: Uncle Rico edged out malle_dips_pouches 125.78 to 120.58, halting a three-game losing skid. Carrying a dismal 1-9-0 historical record against malle_dips_pouches into the matchup, Uncle Rico capitalized just enough while their opponent left 8.80 points on the bench—specifically keeping Brenton Strange on the pine instead of Garrett Wilson—which mathematically cost malle_dips_pouches a 3.60-point win.

matchup_recaps.headline: Post Mahomes Invents New Ways to Waste 31 Points
matchup_recaps.body: Pop Lockett Drop it improved to 3-1-0 by defeating Post Mahomes 125.26 to 105.20. The 20.06-point margin understates a roster malfunction where four avoidable decisions kept Devaughn Vele, RJ Harvey, Ollie Gordon II, and Alvin Kamara benched while Chase Brown, Jaylen Warren, Cam Skattebo, and Ladd McConkey underperformed in active slots.

matchup_recaps.headline: The Undefeated Juggernaut Keeps Rolling
matchup_recaps.body: ThreatLevelMidnight moved to 4-0-0 with a dominant 143.12 to 107.52 victory over Patty Primetimes, recording the week's highest score. Patty Primetimes saw a four-game winning streak snapped alongside a dubious milestone: their 50th career loss. Leaving 23.60 points on the bench compounded the misery as DJ Moore and Josh Downs misfired in the starting lineup.

matchup_recaps.headline: Gronkowski Claims a Comfortable Victory
matchup_recaps.body: The Big Gronkowski climbed to 2-2-0 by taking down Malle ❤️ 🐸 136.58 to 100.12. Historical precedent held as The Big Gronkowski padded their lopsided 11-3-0 head-to-head advantage, operating at an 86.79% lineup efficiency while leaving 20.78 points stranded on the bench.

matchup_recaps.headline: Ginger FC Snaps the Skid in Style
matchup_recaps.body: Ginger FC halted a two-game slide by dismantling Voldemort 127.78 to 81.42. The victors posted a 91.88% efficiency with only 11.3 points left on the bench, dropping Voldemort to 1-3-0 despite the loser keeping bench waste to a meager 4.7 points.

matchup_recaps.headline: The Luckiest Win of the Week Goes to Joe Mantegna
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna scraped together a 104.68 to 58.20 win over Buttermilk Puuump in the week's biggest blowout, though metrics rate it the premier lucky win of Week 4 with an expected win rate of just 27.27%. Buttermilk Puuump sinks deeper into last place at 0-4-0 with 334.4 total points on the season.

managerial_desk.headline: The Weekly Autopsy of Left-Behind Points
managerial_desk.body: Lineup efficiency dictated survival in Week 4. Post Mahomes delivered the crown jewel of managerial disaster, leaking 31.20 points onto the bench for a 77.13% efficiency rating. Deploying Chase Brown, Jaylen Warren, Cam Skattebo, and Ladd McConkey ahead of Devaughn Vele, RJ Harvey, Ollie Gordon II, and Alvin Kamara turned a projected 11.14-point win into a 20.06-point defeat. Buttermilk Puuump followed with 25.40 pine-points in a 46.48-point blowout, while Patty Primetimes left 23.60 points parked behind DJ Moore and Josh Downs.

luck_report.headline: Expected Wins Meet Brutal Reality
luck_report.body: Joe Mantegna secured a 104.68-point victory despite ranking 9th in weekly scoring, earning the week's luckiest designation with a 27.27% expected win rate and a 3-8 all-play record. Conversely, malle_dips_pouches suffered the week's most glaring bad beat, posting 120.58 points—good for 6th on the weekly leaderboard—only to run into Uncle Rico's 125.78-point surge. With a 6-5 all-play record and a 54.55% expected win rate, malle_dips_pouches deserved better than a 5.2-point loss.

players_of_the_week.headline: Explosive Starters and Pine Piles
players_of_the_week.body: ThreatLevelMidnight paced the entire slate with 143.12 total points, proving that high efficiency and proper roster deployment translate directly to the top of the standings. At the opposite extreme, Buttermilk Puuump's meager 58.20 points stand as the lowest offensive output of the week, anchoring the bottom of the 2026 table.

record_book.headline: Milestones and Streak Adjustments
record_book.body: Patty Primetimes hit an unenvied career milestone in Week 4, notching their 50th career loss during a 35.6-point defeat to ThreatLevelMidnight that also ended a four-game winning streak. Elsewhere, Ginger FC snapped a two-game skid, Uncle Rico ended a three-game slide, and malle_dips_pouches saw their three-game winning streak halted by Uncle Rico.

next_week.headline: Week 5 Horizon: Grudges, Models, and Historical Scores

previews.headline: History Favors Gronkowski Against a Projected Favorite
previews.body: The Big Gronkowski holds a 6-3-0 historical edge across nine prior meetings, outscoring malle_dips_pouches 964.88 to 893.88. However, the projection model looks past past precedent, siding firmly with malle_dips_pouches at 123.97 points compared to The Big Gronkowski's 96.35.

previews.headline: Dead-Even Rivalry Meets a Tight Projection
previews.body: The historical series is dead even at 6-6-0 through 12 contests, with Voldemort holding a 1360.76 to 1264.04 points-against advantage. The projection model anticipates a razor-thin battle, pegging Voldemort at 102.20 and Malle ❤️ 🐸 at 98.71.

previews.headline: Historical Advantage Meets Model Optimism
previews.body: Patty Primetimes holds a 4-3-0 historical edge against Joe Mantegna across seven prior meetings while leading 746.66 to 677.12 in total points. The projection model expects Patty Primetimes to maintain the upper hand at 112.10 points over Joe Mantegna's 89.34.

previews.headline: Post Mahomes Seeks to Overturn History
previews.body: History favors Post Mahomes in this clash, holding a 9-5-0 edge over ThreatLevelMidnight across 14 meetings and leading 1542.50 to 1352.56 in historical points. Despite the historical deficit, the undefeated ThreatLevelMidnight commands a heavy projection advantage at 109.23 to 84.90.

previews.headline: Pop Lockett Looks to Protect Lopsided History
previews.body: Pop Lockett Drop it holds a commanding 8-3-0 historical advantage over Uncle Rico through 11 prior matchups, backed by 1235.60 total points. The projection model favors Uncle Rico at 94.19 points to Pop Lockett Drop it's 82.06.

previews.headline: Ginger FC Defends a Narrow Historical Edge
previews.body: Ginger FC holds a slight 3-2-0 historical edge over Buttermilk Puuump across five previous meetings, leading 528.34 to 525.82 in total points. The projection model leans toward Ginger FC at 93.24 points compared to Buttermilk Puuump's 88.54.

closing_shot: Post Mahomes left 31.2 points on the bench, turning a winning optimal score into a 20.06-point loss.
